---
title: Custom Modules
---

### Custom parser

For a custom parser, subclass `searchagent.llm.parsers.Parser` and configure its
import path:

```yaml
agent:
  parser:
    type: custom
    target: pkg://my_project.parsers:MyParser
```


`Parser.to_model()` prepares the message history. `Parser.from_model()` yields
provider-independent assistant messages. Parsers that set `uses_provider_tools` also receive OpenAI-style tool schemas through the provider request.
